reviewDescription: I love these!! Got these for work and they hold a long charge. I don’t use these as often but I can go days without charging them, like a week or more and they still hold a charge. I love how you can take off the microphone if I want to listen to music. The sound quality is good but when I talk on them I can’t hear myself lol so I have to take one headphone off slightly which doesn’t bother me much I they’re like noise canceling headphones. For music it’s good or to cancel noise. I like how it updates you if you have a full change or medium/low when you turn it on. Also, I like how you can adjust the mic and charge it with the small cable it came with. It came with a case too. I love that they’re wireless!! I can walk around my home while I’m on hold and do things while I wait lol. I needed wireless because I had wired ones from work and sometimes I have to get up and I can’t get walk away from my desk if I’m they’re wired.
